examples.en: We ourselves hidden out of sight and bathed in this life-giving stream.
examples.zh: 让我们浸沉在这生命的水泉里沐浴，把我们自己藏起来不被看见。

examples.en: It's almost as if they left their life-giving signatures on my flawed flesh.
examples.zh: 他们仿佛在我有了瑕疵的肌肉上留下了赋予生命的签字。

examples.en: It is in health workers themselves that knowledge becomes life-giving action.
examples.zh: 只有通过卫生工作者，知识才能成为赋予生命的行动。
